title: Asset sale — Alderwick Greenhouses LLC
forum: Minnesota private asset purchase; no court proceeding

documents.title: Greenhouse asset agreement excerpt
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Section 5.3 requires seller’s bench inventory twenty-five calendar days after the asset agreement was signed. Section 8.1 sets closing thirty-eight calendar days after the asset agreement was signed. No court counting rules or weekend adjustment apply.

documents.title: Bench inventory draft
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Inventory includes twelve rolling benches and the solar shade screen. Two benches need caster replacement; the draft lists them separately.

clientFacing.status: The buyer needs the final bench list before the sale closes.
nextSteps: Check the two benches marked for repair.
